about.title: About me
about.p2: Atalaya pulls dev job listings from eight boards, scores them against a profile and drafts the cover letter with an LLM. SaveMyMoneyNow turns bank statements into a spending dashboard: it detects the header row and maps the columns without needing a parser per bank.
about.languages: Native Spanish and Valencian, intermediate English
about.p3: At Anuubis Solutions I keep web infrastructure running in production: deploys, migrations between providers, performance audits and incidents. Nearly all of it scripted, because doing it by hand is where things break.
about.lead: I build applications with React, Node and MongoDB, and automate the repetitive parts with Python.

bullets: I run web infrastructure in production: deploys, migrations between hosting providers and audits.
I replace manual work with Python and Bash scripts: what was done site by site now runs in a single pass.
I diagnose outages end to end: plugins, vhosts, mail delivery, DNS and certificates.
I measure with Lighthouse and Core Web Vitals, and hand over the report with the before and after numbers.
On-site and remote incidents through ticketing and phone.
Machine setup, disk cloning and corporate accounts.

projects.title: WordPress automation in production
projects.description: Python and Bash tooling to operate WordPress sites in production: audits, post deploy verification and migrations between providers. What used to be done site by site now runs in a single pass.

projects.title: SaveMyMoneyNow
projects.description: Turns into a spending dashboard the statements every bank exports its own way. An assistant detects the header row and maps the columns without needing a parser per bank, then rules categorise movements and drop duplicates. 21 endpoints and 66 test cases.

projects.title: Atalaya
projects.description: Python CLI that pulls remote dev listings, scores them against your profile and drafts the cover letter. Strictly typed with mypy.

projects.title: Strev
projects.description: Private beta MERN fitness SaaS: 115 endpoints across 26 modules, with cookie auth, payments, gamification and routines generated by an LLM. 133 test files.
